title: SBPR.QaHarness.T022 request (ADR-0009 §3) — M1
description: A control request = the authenticated envelope (envelope.schema.json) plus a verb drawn from the finite, closed catalog (VerbCatalog.cs). The catalog is the ONLY set of verbs that can exist; a per-run capability manifest permits a SUBSET, never a superset. Every verb argument is typed and bounded; undeclared arguments are rejected (closed schema). This document pins the catalog + argument bounds as the wire truth; the authoritative bounds live in qa/SBPR.QaHarness.T022/Contracts/VerbCatalog.cs.

verbName.description: The finite verb catalog. Fixture verbs are Server-role (per-peer ZRpc); action verbs are Client-role (loopback); observation/lifecycle verbs are either role. `sbpr_master` is the Client-role RELAY of the product's OWN admin verb (discriminator 1=offer, 2=buy): the harness grants nothing and holds no key — the product re-checks its seam config, the transport-authenticated peer, admin membership, the bound principal, and the Bond/Attunement/AP preconditions server-side. Its receipt proves DELIVERY only, never that entitlement applied; the server log is the sole truth for that.

argumentBounds.description: Non-normative summary of the typed argument bounds enforced by VerbCatalog/VerbArg. AllowlistedId: exact static-allowlist id, length 1..128. BoundedInt qty: 1..64. BoundedDouble radius/posRadius: 0..8. BoundedInt targetQuality: 1..4. BoundedString slot: 1..32. BoundedString phase/scope: 1..16.
